theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Communication Svcs (+1.25%) and Consumer Discretionary (+1.06%) led the market today, while Utilities (-1.09%) and Technology (-1.08%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +0.41% versus -0.37% for defensives and -0.18% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.25%, Dow -0.02%, Nasdaq -0.52% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -1.39%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 0.55% to 14.43, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 2.75% to $4,504.10, crude oil was little changed at $83.44, and bitcoin slipped 0.22% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
